# AstryxToolbar { #anylumino.AstryxToolbar }

```python
AstryxToolbar(children=None, *, label, size='sm', gap=1, **props)
```

Render an Astryx toolbar with optional slots.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Default    |
|----------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| children | ChildInput   | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                               | `None`     |
| label    | str          | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                        | _required_ |
| size     | str          | Astryx component option.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `'sm'`     |
| gap      | int \| float | Astryx spacing step between children.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `1`        |
| **props  | Any          | JSON-safe Toolbar props. Useful keys: orientation, variant, dividers, className, and style. anylumino manages label, size, gap, and optional start/center/end child slots. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Toolbar>. | `{}`       |
